eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 8:16 AM on AUG 17, 2025 Effective until 6:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Mesa, Arizona. Mesa police Department is looking for Ascencion Olea Torrez. He is described as an 85-year-old white male, five feet six inches tall, 150 pounds with white hair and brown eyes. Ascencion was last seen on Sunday 8/17/2025, in the area of Stapley Road and Main Street in Mesa, Arizona, wearing a red and black flannel jacket, black pants and glasses. He left his residence on foot in the middle of the night and suffers from a medical condition which may cause him to be lost and easily confused.  If you have any information on Ascencion Olea Torrez, please contact Mesa Police Department.
